web.description: Co-designed chips, racks, and software to push the pareto frontier to best-in-class throughput and interactivity.
snippets: We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing methods so frontier models can run with best-in-class throughput, latency, cost, and power efficiency for both prefill and decode workloads. Earlier this year our A0 silicon came back from TSMC N4P, and today we are busy validating our first rack-scale product with customers to fulfill $1B in demand.

CSM improves latency and avoids today's cost, reliability, yield, thermal, and compute tradeoffs of SRAM-only chips, 3D DRAM chips, or optics. We've made co-design decisions hand-in-hand with leading AI companies, cloud providers, and hyperscalers. We've tested racks in representative data center deployments, run terabytes of production traffic patterns through our simulator, and had dozens of engineers live overseas for months to co-design deeply with our supply-chain partners.
Distinguished Engineer at Broadcom & VP of Intel's Custom Silicon Group. Shipped 300 million chips across nine A0 products.

Our inference systems are built to push the entire pareto curve on frontier models, including many-trillion-parameter MoEs, long context, and agentic workloads. This required intense co-design, from new chips, packages, PCBs, cold plates, interconnects, and more.
